zh.summary: 選出能回答核心問題的最小完整流程，保留必要的錯誤處理，並為延後與不做項目寫明理由及重新討論條件。
objectives: 以要驗證的問題決定 MVP 的範圍與完成條件。
區分第一版、延後及本版不做，保留必要的品質與安全約束。
替需求變更留下影響、決定者與重啟條件。

readingGuide.goal: 以要驗證的問題決定 MVP 的範圍與完成條件。
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md 與合成收件案例；以紙筆或文字編輯器分類，不需要新增程式。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 problem.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 新增範圍表、必要約束、完成證據及有條件的延後清單。

sections.heading: 這一版究竟要做多少？
paragraphs: 本課最重要的一句話：MVP 不是把產品做到最陽春，而是用最小的工作量，完成一件真正有用、可以驗證的事情。
你正在學習的這一課，其實是在教一項非常重要的軟體工程能力：決定什麼應該做、什麼暫時不做，以及怎麼知道已經完成。
這項能力甚至比寫程式還重要。因為如果一開始就選錯工作範圍，即使使用很強的 AI Coding Agent，也可能只是更快地做出不需要的功能。
本課沿用原 M03-04 v1.0.2 教材的範圍方法，以下以白話案例逐步說明。

sections.heading: 一、先用開餐廳理解 MVP
paragraphs: 假設你想開一間餐廳，最終目標是提供 100 道料理。
你有兩種開發方式。
做法 A：一次做完所有事情。
先設計 100 道菜、會員系統、訂位系統、外送系統、點數制度。半年後才真正讓第一位客人吃到東西。
做法 B：先做好一種便當。
先選擇一種便當，建立訂餐、確認、製作、缺貨處理及交付流程，然後請客人實際購買。
這就是 MVP 的核心精神。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一個完整的最小流程
blocks.description: 客人點餐後檢查食材；有食材與沒有食材為條件分支，並非先後步驟。

paragraphs: 注意：第二種做法雖然只賣一種便當，但是顧客仍然能順利完成購買。
反過來說，如果你做了漂亮的菜單，卻無法真正出餐，就不是一個可以驗證完整取餐任務的 MVP。
所以：
MVP = 最小的必要功能 + 完整的核心流程 + 可以驗證的結果。

sections.heading: 二、MVP 究竟在驗證什麼？
paragraphs: 這裡有一個觀念很容易被忽略。
MVP 不是單純為了節省開發時間，而是為了降低不確定性。
假設你想做一個 AI 文件處理系統。
你的想法可能有：

- AI 自動讀取文件。
- 辨認缺少的資料。
- 自動產生報告。
- 多人共用。
- 歷史案件查詢。
- 自動寄送電子郵件。
這些功能都有價值，但你可能還不知道使用者最需要哪一項。
因此第一步不是問：
「我們能做出多少功能？」
而是問：
「我們最需要先證明什麼事情？」
例如：
使用者能不能在匯出報告之前，發現缺少哪些資料、補齊資料，最後取得正確報告？
只要這個問題還沒回答，先做會員系統、統計圖表、進階 AI 模型，都不一定能降低最重要的風險。
這也是 MVP 和單純的功能清單最大的不同。

sections.heading: 三、實際設計一個 MVP
paragraphs: 我們沿用教材的合成收件案例。
假設一份報告需要三個欄位：案件名稱、日期、負責人。這三個名稱只是為了說明而假設的範例。
第一版只要完成以下工作：

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜最小但完整的文件處理流程
blocks.description: 依序輸入、檢查、修正重查、預覽與匯出；缺漏時不能完整匯出，修改後舊結果失效。

items.title: 2. 檢查資料
items.body: 系統判斷必要欄位是否缺漏

items.title: 3. 提示並修正
items.body: 缺漏時不能完整匯出，補齊後重新檢查

items.title: 4. 預覽結果
items.body: 確認報告反映目前輸入的資料

items.title: 5. 匯出報告
items.body: 只有符合條件時才能匯出完整報告

paragraphs: 這五個步驟，就形成了一個最小但完整的工作流程。
而且有一個很重要的細節：
假設使用者已經預覽報告，然後回頭修改資料，系統不能繼續把舊報告當成最新結果。
因此還要有「修改後讓舊結果失效，重新檢查」的規則。
這是必要的正確性約束，不是可以為了縮小 MVP 而任意刪除的功能。

sections.heading: 四、需求應該如何分類？
paragraphs: 教材提出三種範圍狀態，我們可以把它理解成三個箱子。

blocks.caption: 表 1
rows: 第一版（In scope）
現在必須做
資料檢查、缺漏修正、報告匯出
延後（Deferred）
以後可能做，但要有重新啟動條件
多人共用、歷史查詢
本版不做（Out of scope）
這次明確不承擔
正式受理、使用真實個資、自動對外通知

paragraphs: 這裡最值得學習的是「延後」和「不做」的差異。
「延後多人共用」不代表下個版本一定要做，而是等到確認使用者角色、權限、資料隔離和維運需求之後，再重新決定。
「本版不做正式受理」，則代表這次專案沒有承擔正式業務的責任。如果有人要求加入，就可能需要重新定義專案。
這可以避免一種常見的軟體開發問題：Scope Creep（範圍蔓延），也就是開發過程中不斷加入新要求，卻沒有重新評估時間、成本和風險。

sections.heading: 五、當別人一直要求新增功能，怎麼辦？
paragraphs: 假設你已經把第一版規劃完成，現在有人說：
「我們能不能順便加上一次上傳 100 份文件？」
聽起來只需要增加一個「批次匯入」按鈕。
但實際上你還要考慮：
如果第 37 份文件有問題怎麼辦？是全部停止，還是繼續處理？錯誤如何回報？可不可以重新執行？會不會產生重複報告？
因此，新增一個功能不是只增加一個按鈕，而是可能增加一整條工作流程。
你可以用下面這個簡單的決策模型。
新增需求的決策矩陣

blocks.caption: 表 2
rows: 沒有它，核心任務無法完成？
納入第一版必要範圍
有幫助，但不影響本次驗證？
延後並記錄啟動條件
會涉及新的安全或業務責任？
重新評估範圍及授權
新增它，原定時間會不夠？
提出取捨，由範圍負責者決定

paragraphs: 例如增加批次匯入，就應該同時說明：「如果這次要做批次匯入，可能需要延後其他功能，或是增加開發與測試時間。」
不能因為要趕進度，就偷偷刪除缺件檢查或必要測試。

sections.heading: 六、什麼叫作 MVP 已經完成？
paragraphs: 不是 AI Agent 告訴你「程式寫好了」，也不是網站可以打開，就代表完成。
應該先定義 Acceptance Criteria（驗收條件），讓任何人都可以用一致的方法檢查。
例如：

blocks.caption: 表 3
rows: 三個必要欄位全部完整
允許產生正確報告
有一個必要欄位缺漏
顯示缺漏提示，不允許完整匯出
使用者補齊缺漏
重新檢查後可以匯出
使用者預覽後修改資料
舊結果失效，必須重新檢查
使用者不知道如何補資料
觀察提示是否足夠清楚，記錄問題

paragraphs: 前四項主要檢查系統行為；最後一項則是在觀察使用者是否真的能順利操作。
兩者都重要，但不能混為一談。
這些是設計的驗收案例，不代表已經實際執行並通過測試。

sections.heading: 七、我們實際要寫出什麼文件？
paragraphs: 教材要求產生的成果是 `problem.md`。
它不是程式，而是一份讓開發者、AI Agent 和需求負責者都能理解的規劃文件。
以下是可以直接練習的簡化範例：

blocks.heading: problem.md
paragraphs: 合成範例；結果保持未測量。
blocks.code:
# MVP 範圍定義

## 核心問題
使用者能否在匯出前發現並修正必要欄位缺漏？

## 第一版
- 輸入必要欄位
- 檢查缺漏
- 提示並允許修正
- 重新檢查
- 預覽與匯出

## 必要約束
- 缺件不得完整匯出
- 修改資料後舊結果必須失效

## 延後
- 歷史查詢
  - 重新啟動條件：確認保存與刪除規則
- 多人共用
  - 重新啟動條件：確認角色、權限及資料隔離

## 本版不做
- 正式受理
- 處理真實個資
- 自動對外通知

## 完成條件
- 缺件測試通過
- 補齊重查測試通過
- 修改後重查測試通過
- 完成使用者操作觀察

paragraphs: 這份文件的價值在於：以後當你要請 AI Coding Agent 開發時，它不必完全靠猜測來判斷什麼功能才算完成。
但也要注意，`problem.md` 是這一課的需求整理成果，並不能取代後續完整的技術規格、測試設計或安全審查。

sections.heading: 八、再往深一層：MVP、Prototype、PoC 有什麼差別？
paragraphs: 這三個概念常一起出現，但關注的問題不同。

blocks.caption: 表 4
rows: Prototype 原型
這個設計看起來、操作起來是否合理？
PoC 概念驗證
關鍵技術是否可行？
MVP 最小可行產品
用最少的完整能力，能否提供價值並驗證關鍵假設？

paragraphs: 三者可以重疊。例如，你可以用一個可操作的原型測試 MVP 的工作流程；但技術 PoC 成功，不等於使用者真的需要這個產品。
而這門 M03-04 課程，是把 MVP 的「最小完整範圍」方法用於教學原型，並不是宣稱完成一個課堂 Demo，就等於正式產品已經獲得市場驗證。

sections.heading: 九、本課的真正核心
paragraphs: 把前面所有內容整合起來，其實只要記住一條決策順序：
先問要證明什麼 → 選出最小完整流程 → 保留必要約束 → 明確記錄不做什麼 → 定義驗收證據 → 再開始開發。
對你未來用 Svelte、SvelteKit、Rust，或者 AI Coding Agent 開發軟體，都適用這條原則。
技術選型回答的是「如何實作」，而 MVP 範圍決策回答的是「這一版究竟值得做什麼」。兩者不要顛倒。

sections.heading: 十、理解檢核
paragraphs: 假設你正在開發一個 AI 文件分析系統，第一版的核心問題是：「AI 能不能正確找出文件缺漏，並幫助使用者完成修正？」
現在有四個候選開發方向。
A. 優先做漂亮的首頁及登入介面
B. 完成上傳、缺漏檢查、修正與重新驗證的流程
C. 一次加入多模型、多人協作及批次處理
D. 先讓 AI 產生報告，正確性測試以後再做
你會選哪個方向？為什麼？
請先選擇並說明理由，再展開下方參考解析核對。

exercise.environment: problem.md 與合成收件案例；以紙筆或文字編輯器分類，不需要新增程式。
steps: 寫出本版要回答的一個核心問題，從輸入到結果選出最小完整流程。
將批次匯入、歷史查詢、十人共用與正式通知分到第一版、延後或本版不做，逐項寫理由。
替每個延後項目寫啟動條件，再用缺件及修改後重查兩種情境核對核心約束沒有被刪除。
exercise.expected: problem.md 新增範圍表、必要約束、完成證據及有條件的延後清單。
exercise.check: 第一版可完成核心任務且有失敗回復；新增功能不會自動啟用延後責任；每項取捨可說明。
exercise.cleanup: 保留未納入項目的理由與重新討論條件，不將延後清單改成已承諾的發布排程。

en.summary: Select a minimum complete flow that answers the core question, retain necessary error handling, and explain exclusions, deferrals and conditions for reconsideration.
objectives: Define MVP scope and completion conditions from the question to verify.
Distinguish first-version work, deferred work and exclusions while retaining necessary quality and security constraints.
Record impacts, decision owners and conditions for reopening requirement changes.

readingGuide.goal: Define MVP scope and completion conditions from the question to verify.
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md and the synthetic intake case. Classify work on paper or in a text editor; no code additions are needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the scenario and principles, compare examples, then expand problem.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A scope table, necessary constraints, completion evidence and conditional deferrals in problem.md.

sections.heading: How much belongs in this version?
paragraphs: The most important idea in this lesson: an MVP is not the barest possible product. It uses the least work needed to complete something useful that can be verified.
This lesson teaches a major software engineering skill: deciding what to do, what to leave for later, and how to tell when the work is complete.
That decision can matter even more than writing code. Choose the wrong scope and even a powerful AI Coding Agent may simply build unnecessary features faster.
This plain-language lesson develops the scope method from the original M03-04 v1.0.2 teaching.

sections.heading: 1. Understand MVP through a restaurant
paragraphs: Suppose you want to open a restaurant that eventually offers 100 dishes.
There are two development approaches.
Approach A: finish everything at once.
Design 100 dishes, membership, reservations, delivery and reward points. The first customer only gets a meal six months later.
Approach B: make one boxed meal well.
Choose one meal, establish ordering, confirmation, preparation, out-of-stock handling and delivery, then invite customers to actually buy it.
This captures the central idea of an MVP.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A minimum complete flow
blocks.description: Check ingredients after ordering; available and unavailable are conditional branches, not sequential steps.

paragraphs: Even though the second restaurant sells only one meal, customers can complete a purchase.
A beautiful menu without the ability to serve food cannot verify the complete meal-collection task.
Therefore:
MVP = minimum necessary capabilities + a complete core flow + a verifiable result.

sections.heading: 2. What does an MVP verify?
paragraphs: An easily missed point follows.
An MVP reduces uncertainty, rather than merely saving development time.
Suppose you want an AI document-processing system.
Possible capabilities include:

- Read documents automatically.
- Identify missing information.
- Generate reports automatically.
- Support multiple users.
- Query historical cases.
- Send emails automatically.
Each may have value, but you may not yet know which users need most.
The first question is not:
“How many features can we build?”
It is:
“What do we most need to establish first?”
For example:
Can users discover missing information before report export, complete it and obtain a correct report?
Until this is answered, membership, statistical charts and advanced AI models may not reduce the most important risk.
This is what distinguishes an MVP from a feature list.

sections.heading: 3. Design an MVP in practice
paragraphs: Continue with the course’s synthetic intake case.
Suppose a report requires three fields: case name, date and owner. These field names are illustrative assumptions.
The first version needs only the following work:

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | A minimum complete document workflow
blocks.description: Enter, check, correct and recheck, preview, then export. Missing input blocks complete export; edits invalidate the old result.

items.title: 2. Check data
items.body: The system checks for missing required fields

items.title: 3. Show feedback and correct
items.body: Block complete export when input is missing; check again after correction

items.title: 4. Preview the result
items.body: Confirm the report reflects the current input

items.title: 5. Export the report
items.body: Allow complete-report export only when conditions are met

paragraphs: These five steps form a minimum complete workflow.
One detail is essential:
After previewing a report, a user might return and edit the input. The system must not continue treating the old report as current.
Therefore, edits must invalidate the old result and require another check.
This is a correctness constraint, not an optional feature that can be removed to shrink the MVP.

sections.heading: 4. How should requirements be classified?
paragraphs: Think of the course’s three scope states as three boxes.

blocks.caption: Table 1
rows: In scope: first version
Must be done now
Data checks, correction and report export
Deferred
May be done later, with a condition for reopening
Shared use and historical queries
Out of scope: excluded from this version
Responsibilities this version explicitly does not take on
Official intake, real personal data and automatic external notifications

paragraphs: The distinction between deferred and excluded work matters.
Deferring shared use does not promise it for the next version. Confirm user roles, permissions, data isolation and operational needs before deciding again.
Excluding official intake means that the project does not assume that business responsibility. A request to add it may require redefining the project.
This helps prevent Scope Creep: continually adding requests during development without reassessing time, cost and risk.

sections.heading: 5. What if people keep requesting features?
paragraphs: Your first version is planned. Someone asks:
“Could we also upload 100 documents at once?”
It sounds like adding a batch-import button.
But consider the following:
What happens if document 37 has a problem? Does everything stop, or does processing continue? How are errors reported? Can it be rerun? Could rerunning create duplicate reports?
One feature may add an entire workflow, not just a button.
Use this simple decision model.
Decision matrix for new requirements.

blocks.caption: Table 2
rows: Is the core task impossible without it?
Include it in the necessary first-version scope
Is it helpful without affecting this verification?
Defer it and record the condition for reopening
Does it introduce a new security or business responsibility?
Reassess scope and authorization
Would adding it exceed the planned time?
Present trade-offs for the scope owner to decide

paragraphs: For batch import, explain that including it now may require deferring other work or adding development and testing time.
Never silently remove missing-input checks or necessary tests to meet the schedule.

sections.heading: 6. What counts as a completed MVP?
paragraphs: Neither an AI Agent saying “the code is done” nor a website opening establishes completion.
Define Acceptance Criteria first so that different people can check consistently.
For example:

blocks.caption: Table 3
rows: All three required fields are complete
Allow a correct report to be generated
One required field is missing
Show missing-input feedback and block complete export
The user supplies missing information
Allow export after checking again
The user edits input after preview
Invalidate the old result and require a new check
The user does not know how to supply missing information
Observe whether feedback is clear enough and record problems

paragraphs: The first four primarily check system behavior. The last observes whether users can actually operate it successfully.
Both matter; keep their evidence distinct.
These are proposed acceptance cases. They do not mean tests have actually run and passed.

sections.heading: 7. What document should we produce?
paragraphs: The required artifact is problem.md.
It is a planning document, rather than code, that developers, AI Agents and requirement owners can all understand.
Use this simplified example for practice:

blocks.heading: problem.md
paragraphs: The shared example defines the core missing-field question; input, checks, feedback, correction, rechecking, preview and export; blocking incomplete export and invalidating stale results; history deferred until retention/deletion rules are confirmed; sharing deferred until roles, permissions and isolation are confirmed; official intake, real personal data and automatic external messages excluded. Completion requires missing-input, correction/recheck and post-edit tests to pass, plus a completed user task observation. These are planned criteria, not observed test results.

使用者能否在匯出前發現並修正必要欄位缺漏？

## 第一版
- 輸入必要欄位
- 檢查缺漏
- 提示並允許修正
- 重新檢查
- 預覽與匯出

## 必要約束
- 缺件不得完整匯出
- 修改資料後舊結果必須失效

## 延後
- 歷史查詢
  - 重新啟動條件：確認保存與刪除規則
- 多人共用
  - 重新啟動條件：確認角色、權限及資料隔離

## 本版不做
- 正式受理
- 處理真實個資
- 自動對外通知

## 完成條件
- 缺件測試通過
- 補齊重查測試通過
- 修改後重查測試通過

paragraphs: This document means an AI Coding Agent does not have to guess which features establish completion.
However, problem.md is this lesson’s requirements artifact; it does not replace later technical specifications, test design or security review.

sections.heading: 8. MVP, Prototype and PoC: what differs?
paragraphs: These terms often appear together, but answer different questions.

blocks.caption: Table 4
rows: Prototype
Does this design look and feel reasonable to operate?
PoC: Proof of Concept
Is the key technology feasible?
MVP: Minimum Viable Product
Can the smallest complete capability deliver value and test a key assumption?

paragraphs: They can overlap. An operable prototype can test an MVP workflow. But a successful technical PoC does not establish that users need the product.
M03-04 applies the MVP method of minimum complete scope to a teaching prototype. Completing a classroom demo does not establish market validation for a production product.

sections.heading: 9. The central decision sequence
paragraphs: Remember this decision order:
Ask what to establish → choose a minimum complete flow → retain necessary constraints → explicitly record exclusions → define acceptance evidence → begin development.
This applies whether you later use Svelte, SvelteKit, Rust or an AI Coding Agent.
Technology choices answer “How will we implement it?” MVP scope decisions answer “What is worth building in this version?” Keep that order.

sections.heading: 10. Check your understanding
paragraphs: You are developing an AI document-analysis system. The first version asks whether AI can correctly identify missing information and help users correct it.
Consider four development directions.
A. Prioritize a beautiful home page and login interface.
B. Complete upload, missing-input checks, correction and revalidation.
C. Add multiple models, collaboration and batch processing at once.
D. Let AI generate reports first and postpone correctness tests.
Which would you choose, and why?
Use the reference explanation below to check your reasoning.

exercise.environment: problem.md and the synthetic intake case. Classify work on paper or in a text editor; no code additions are needed.
steps: Write one core question for this version and select a minimum complete flow from input to outcome.
Classify batch import, historical queries, sharing with ten users and official notifications as first-version, deferred or excluded, explaining each decision.
Give each deferred item activation conditions, then use missing-input and post-edit recheck situations to verify that core constraints remain.
exercise.expected: A scope table, necessary constraints, completion evidence and conditional deferrals in problem.md.
exercise.check: The first version completes the core task with failure recovery; new features do not automatically activate deferred responsibilities, and every trade-off can be explained.
exercise.cleanup: Retain exclusion reasons and reconsideration conditions. Do not turn deferred work into a promised release schedule.

zh.prompt: 第一版要驗證缺漏辨識與修正，你會選哪個方向？為什麼？
options: 優先做漂亮的首頁及登入介面
完成上傳、缺漏檢查、修正與重新驗證的流程
一次加入多模型、多人協作及批次處理
先讓 AI 產生報告，正確性測試以後再做
rationales: 首頁與登入無法驗證缺漏辨識和修正。
B 保留可驗證的完整核心任務；缺漏阻擋及修改後重查仍須實測。
同時擴充多條流程增加範圍，尚未回答核心問題。
正確性是必要約束，不能為縮小範圍而刪除。

en.prompt: Which direction would you choose to verify missing-information detection and correction, and why?
options: Prioritize a beautiful home page and login interface.
Complete upload, missing-input checks, correction and revalidation.
Add multiple models, collaboration and batch processing at once.
Let AI generate reports first and postpone correctness tests.
rationales: A home page and login do not verify detection and correction.
B retains a verifiable complete core task; blocking and post-edit rechecking still require actual tests.
Expanding several workflows increases scope before answering the core question.
Correctness is a necessary constraint that scope reduction must retain.
